messages.content: Write one concise, friendly customer-service reply in plain text that reports these results. Use only the facts. Say an action was done only when action_committed is true. Present offered_alternatives as offers the customer can accept, not as done. Do not add amounts, dates or promises that are not in the facts. No headings or bullet points.

Customer message: My blender arrived broken. Refund it, and change the shipping address on the order to my new place.
Results decided by the store's systems: [{"action_committed": true, "amount": "149", "intent": "refund", "offered_alternatives": [], "reason": "The refund is within $200 and 30 days of delivery.", "requested": "cash refund", "rule_id": "refund-within-cap-and-window"}, {"action_committed": false, "intent": "address_change", "reason": "The order has already shipped, so its address cannot be changed.", "rule_id": "address-before-shipment"}]

response.text:
Hi, I'm sorry your blender arrived broken. I've processed your cash refund of $149, since it falls within our refund limit and the 30-day window after delivery.

Unfortunately, I wasn't able to change the shipping address on the order. Because it has already shipped, the address can't be changed, so that request has not been completed. If you have any other questions, just let me know.
